responsibility: Declares the small shared data model for locality-based LTO partition planning. This header defines locality_partition objects, which record a partition identifier, the cgraph nodes assigned to that locality partition, and accumulated instruction-size estimates, and exports the global vector of planned partitions used by the locality-cloning pass and later WPA partitioning logic.
same_name_distinction: Provides only the shared interface for the locality-cloning module: the locality_partition data structure typedef and extern declaration of locality_partitions that other WPA/LTO partitioning code can use, without the pass logic or cloning algorithms implemented in the .cc file.
